renderer: ThreeCanvas (@remotion/three); 4x MSAA half-float targets; motion blur by shutter-sample accumulation in linear light

formulas.u: fract(i/12 + travel)  (while a near card is still exiting frame after the wrap, u continues past 1 until it has fully left frame, then recycles)

motionBlur.samples: 8-48 adaptive (<= 1.1px between samples where possible); 1 when static

recycling.rule: A card is recycled to the far end only once its projected 2x2 rect clears every frame edge by the margin; it reappears at u~0 with depth fade ~0.

text.positioning: screen-fixed, horizontally centred on x=960; block optically centred on y=540

protection.kind: local card-opacity reduction in the card fragment shader (screen space)
protection.shape: smooth union of three horizontal capsules (one per text line) with a smoothstep feather; no straight edges, never a rectangle
